name: fast-llm-compaction
description: Tool-call summarizing compaction for Claude Code sessions: every tool result over 200 chars becomes one sentence from the session's own model — what it found, why it matters, what follows from it.

minResultChars.title: Minimum result characters
minResultChars.description: Tool results at or below this many characters are kept verbatim; only longer ones are summarized.

maxToolInputChars.title: Maximum tool input characters
maxToolInputChars.description: Serialized tool inputs above this many characters are condensed to their informative skeleton.

maxPromptResultChars.title: Maximum result characters in the question
maxPromptResultChars.description: Characters of a tool result put in front of the session model with the question.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when no summary could be obtained; 0 keeps only the note.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated reduction the built-in summary runs instead.

preSummarize.title: Ask as tool calls land
preSummarize.description: Put the question to the session model as tool results arrive (tool.call), so compaction reuses ready sentences.

preSummarizeAtPercent.title: Ask from percentage
preSummarizeAtPercent.description: Context percentage from which tool.call starts asking; 0 always.

concurrency.title: Question concurrency
concurrency.description: How many questions to the session model may be in flight at once.

batchSize.title: Tool calls per question
batchSize.description: How many tool calls one batch question asks about; the context behind the question is paid once per batch.
